name: language-tutor
description: Веб-приложение для изучения языков с голосовым диалогом (STT/LLM/TTS)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lt/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @lt/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build -w @lt/shared && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lt/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
